candidates.change_summary: Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;` so a deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender]-=msg.value;` so deposits decrease instead of increase the balance.
Replace the guard `msg.value >= MinDeposit` with `msg.value > MinDeposit` so a deposit of exactly MinDeposit no longer updates balances.
Delete the balance update statement `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` so deposits never change balances.
Remove the balance update statement so deposits no longer credit the sender's balance.
Change the deposit threshold from >= to > so a deposit of exactly MinDeposit is no longer credited.
Replace the accumulated balance update with an assignment so each deposit overwrites rather than accumulates.
Credit the deposit to tx.origin instead of msg.sender so balances observed via the mapping differ.
Delete the balance deduction so CashOut never decreases balances[msg.sender].
Delete the revert on failed external call so the balance is deducted even when the ether transfer fails.
Move the balance deduction after the external call, enabling reentrancy with an outdated balance.
Change the guard to a strict inequality so withdrawing the exact full balance is no longer allowed.
Replace the guard with a comparison against MinDeposit so withdrawals are limited by MinDeposit instead of the caller's balance.
